summary.text: Hu Elevation is an immortal killer move named when Qi Sea Ancestor uses it.

claims.text: Qi Sea Ancestor summons a secluded domain of heaven and earth above his head. Demon Immortal Qi Jue and Seven Fiendish Primeval Monarch shout Hu Land. He aims toward Book Mountain. Fairy Yu Xiu stands between him and Book Mountain. Immortal killer move Hu Elevation is named. Hu Land shakes as qi currents shoot out of it. Righteous qi, evil qi, blood qi, strange qi, and others gather into a single force. A thick qi beam flies toward Book Mountain. Fairy Yu Xiu uses her strongest defensive method. Wisdom path insignias melt as the beam submerges her, and the beam loses thirty percent of its power. Bai Cang Shui charges with Heavenly Court’s rank eight Immortal Gu House. The house lasts a few breaths, then disintegrates. Star Constellation Chessboard brings Bai Cang Shui away. Without her, the house is destroyed to scraps, then blown to oblivion. The beam weakens by another twenty percent. Qing Chou raises its shield and blocks the beam. The qi pillar sends Qing Chou crashing into Book Mountain, leaving a pit hundreds of feet deep. The shield is destroyed, and a hole opens through Qing Chou’s chest. Divine Emperor City sucks Qing Chou’s dead body back. Fairy Yu Xiu appears pale and falls to a half-kneeling position. The move defeated Yu Xiu, destroyed the Immortal Gu House, and killed Qing Chou in one move. After using it, Qi Sea Ancestor lost thirty percent of his immortal essence storage and expended ten thousand qi path dao marks.
Immortal killer move Hu Elevation is named. The qi path killer move descends. The immortals evade, including Qi Jue and Lu Wei Yin.
Immortal killer move Hu Elevation is named. A qi path killer move descends, temporarily blocking a venerable.

Qi Sea Ancestor gives a shout. Immortal killer move Hu Elevation is named. Towering qi pillars shoot out, piercing through Skeleton grotto-heaven. Granny Skeleton has no time to dodge and is annihilated by the qi pillar.
